payload.reason: The evidence provides clear information on how text is segmented for processing in document classification, specifically in the context of legal documents.

claims.text: Text is segmented into smaller chunks to improve the encapsulation of context and enhance classification results.
The segmentation process is inspired by audio segmentation techniques, which also involve dividing content into manageable parts for better comprehension.
Dividing lengthy documents into segments allows the neural network to process each chunk effectively, mimicking human reading behavior.
